record.question: Which political party was commonly known as ‘Zalen Pawl’?
record.explanation: Answer D: UMFO. Zalen Pawl was the United Mizo Freedom Organisation (UMFO), distinct from its political rival Mizo Union. Mizoram University’s Department of Mizo journal explicitly identifies UMFO as Zalen Pawl on printedpage41/physicalpage45 in its January–March2021 volume. The initial Mizo Union recommendation is rejected. Reference: https://mizostudiesmzu.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Mizo-Studies-Volume-X-No.-1-Jan-March-2021.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
